question: Should maintainers rebase and land this additive route-list contract as the fix for the linked mobile pairing blocker?
rationale: The PR is protected by maintainer handling, changes public setup/protocol/SDK surfaces, and cannot merge at the exact head until conflicts are resolved.

options.title: Rebase and land the additive contract
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts, keep legacy url plus optional ordered route lists, and rerun pairing, SDK, protocol, and iOS validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Limit the PR to server/protocol route advertisement and defer iOS selection or SDK exposure if maintainers want a smaller first landing path.

options.title: Pause for broader mobile parity
options.body: Hold this PR until Android and other clients get the same route fallback semantics, accepting that the iOS blocker stays open meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land the additive contract
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflicts, keep legacy url plus optional ordered route lists, and rerun pairing, SDK, protocol, and iOS validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is both the PR author and an officially listed maintainer with recent history on the affected setup-code/mobile pairing paths.
